name: fieldtrack
description: FieldTrack offline-first field issue tracking monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@fieldtrack/client" "npm run dev --workspace=@fieldtrack/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@fieldtrack/client && npm run build --workspace=@fieldtrack/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@fieldtrack/client && npm run lint --workspace=@fieldtrack/server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@fieldtrack/client && npm run test --workspace=@fieldtrack/server
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules client/dist server/dist
